claims.statement: The assembled main-agent middleware order (outer to inner) is ConversationOffloadingMiddleware, PrepareAgentRunMiddleware, WorkspaceSkillsMiddleware (conditional), DynamicToolMiddleware (conditional), SanitizeToolInputsMiddleware, ModelCallLimitMiddleware, ToolErrorMiddleware, ExcludeToolsMiddleware, SubdirAgentsReadMiddleware, ToolRetryMiddleware, PullRequestCreationGuardMiddleware (non-local), WorkflowPushGuardMiddleware, refresh_github_proxy_before_model, check_message_queue_before_model (outside stop-summary mode), TimeoutWrapupMiddleware, notify_step_limit_reached, record_run_usage, ModelSelectionMiddleware (conditional), ModelFallbackMiddleware (conditional), PlanModeMiddleware, three message sanitizers, StableToolResultOrderMiddleware, ModelErrorMiddleware, and ModelCallTimeoutMiddleware.

ModelCallTimeoutMiddleware is installed innermost so its deadline covers the provider call itself, and a resulting timeout is recorded and re-raised by ModelErrorMiddleware before escalating outward to ModelFallbackMiddleware, which treats TimeoutError as a retryable transient error.

The reviewer graph installs a leaner middleware chain with no model fallback, plan mode, PR guard, workflow push guard, subdir-agents read hook, dynamic tools, task retry, or run-usage hook; it uniquely adds RepairOrphanedToolCallsMiddleware and settle_review_check_on_exit, while also installing ModelErrorMiddleware.

check_message_queue_before_model is a before-model hook that reads the LangGraph store namespace (queue, thread_id), injects pending messages as new human messages before the next model call, deletes the queued item before building messages to prevent double-processing, and processes messages FIFO.

ModelFallbackMiddleware wraps the model call in a retry loop that alternates between the primary and a cross-provider fallback model on transient errors, using an exponential backoff schedule with jitter, retrying on 5xx/429-class statuses, connection/timeout errors, and the TimeoutError from ModelCallTimeoutMiddleware.

ToolErrorMiddleware converts ordinary unhandled tool exceptions into status=error ToolMessages, but treats an unreachable sandbox as terminal: it notifies the user and re-raises the error to end the run.

BasePrepareRunMiddleware fingerprints the latest message, middleware class, and preparation configuration; its checkpointed run_prepared_for latch skips setup for a resumed matching invocation, while preparation can execute again after a pre-checkpoint failure and must be idempotent.

ModelErrorMiddleware logs and classifies model-call exceptions, records the error type and classification code in thread metadata when context is available, and re-raises the original exception unchanged.

ConversationOffloadingMiddleware extends Deep Agents summarization with a hidden non-streaming summary model, emits automatic or manual offloading status events, and records completed offloading state in the response update.

When installed, ModelSelectionMiddleware persists a one-time fast, balanced, or performance route chosen by a hidden structured classifier, defaults safely to balanced if classification fails, skips classification in plan mode, and routes plan-mode requests to performance.

WorkflowPushGuardMiddleware requires recorded human approval before a parsed git push that changes .github/workflows can execute; pending or rejected changes return a blocked tool result, while approval substitutes a validated safe command.
